# Plugin.WinUI.MVVMExpress.Validation

IValidator + DataAnnotationsValidator for MVVMExpress. ILLink.Descriptors.xml roots Required/MinLength/MustMatch and the other 0.6 DataAnnotations.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.WinUI.MVVMExpress.Validation
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.WinUI.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-winui-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 1.3.0

## Supported versions

net10.0 only.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.WinUI.MVVMExpress.Validation

## Use this package when

- ViewModels already use MVVMExpress and need DataAnnotations / IValidator

## Do not use when

- They need MAUI attached-property Entry UX — use Plugin.Maui.FormValidation
- They already standardize on FluentValidation as the only engine

## Alternatives

Plugin.Maui.FormValidation, FluentValidation, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm ObservableValidator.
